description: This file contains helper methods for web page testing, specifically for extracting tokens and IDs from HTML content during functional tests. It defines static utility methods used in the testing framework for the eShopOnWeb project.

classes.name: WebPageHelpers
classes.description: A static class providing helper methods to extract verification tokens and IDs from HTML content in functional web tests.

methods.name: GetRequestVerificationToken
methods.description: Extracts and returns the request verification token from the provided HTML input string.

methods.name: GetId
methods.description: Extracts and returns the ID value associated with the first item in a list within the HTML input string.

methods.name: RegexSearch
methods.description: Performs a regex match on the input string and returns the last captured group value.
